test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Town A is to the south of Town B. Town C is to the east of Town B. Town D is to the west of Town C. Town E is to the north of Town D. Town A is to the south-east of Town E. What is the position of Town B with respect to Town D?
solution: Given, Town A is to the south of Town B. Town C is to the east of Town B. Town D is to the west of Town C. Town E is to the north of Town D. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15cc6a299ceccdbbc54caaad9b4a0a71ec1d61a61620f6ec19d6b03b9720868c.png]
